nuggets.text: Caden Creel set career highs with 327 passing yards and five touchdown passes in the Gamecocks' 49-7 win over Eastern Kentucky.
Jamill Williams caught four touchdown passes against Eastern Kentucky, on grabs of 13, 55, 30 and 4 yards.
Jamill Williams, an Albany State transfer from Atlanta, already has four touchdown catches as a Gamecock.
The Gamecocks converted 9 of 11 third downs in last week's 49-7 rout of Eastern Kentucky.
Caden Creel was named MVP of the 2025 Salute to Veterans Bowl after throwing for 173 yards and a touchdown.
Head coach Charles Kelly won national titles as an assistant at Florida State in 2013 and Alabama in 2020.
Charles Kelly first coached at Jax State in 1994 as running backs coach, then returned in 2024 as head coach.
The Gamecocks were once called the Eagle Owls, before becoming the Fighting Gamecocks in 1947.
Jax State's Marching Southerners carry the heavy Conn 20-J upright concert tuba onto the field.
The Marching Southerners use a dance line called the Marching Ballerinas instead of majorettes, a choice dating to 1956.
